findings.description: Hermenejildo Patricio Cherres and Nicolasa Gavilanes had a son, Julio César Cherres, born about 1906, who died on 17 May 1908 and was buried at San Pedro, Guanujo, Guaranda, Bolívar, Ecuador; the parish burial entry names his parents as Patricio Cherres and Nicolasa Gavianes.

target_person.name: Julio César Cherres
target_person.death: 17 May 1908, San Pedro, Guanujo, Guaranda, Bolívar, Ecuador

supporting_sources: Ecuador, Catholic Church Records, 1565-2023 — burial entry for Julio Cesar Cherres, died 17 May 1908, San Pedro de Guanujo parish death register 1894–1915, parents Patricio Cherres and Nicolasa Gavianes
